notes.title: Core Break 1.2.0 – The System Overhaul Update!
notes.content:
[h1] Core Break 1.2.0 – The System Overhaul Update! [/h1]

This is the biggest Core Break update yet! We’ve fine-tuned the entire experience with major improvements, new features, and full Linux support.

[hr][/hr]

[h2] 🐧 Full Linux Support! [/h2]
No more workarounds—Core Break is now fully supported on Linux! Enjoy smooth gameplay on your favorite OS.

[h2] 🔊 Overhauled Audio System! [/h2]
We've rebuilt the sound engine from the ground up! Expect [b]crisper weapon sounds, immersive environmental effects, and dynamic audio adjustments[/b] based on the action.

[h2] 🗺️ The New Map Feature! [/h2]
Lost in the chaos? Not anymore! The new [b]interactive map[/b] helps you navigate the station and plan your escape more effectively.

[h2] 💥 Visual Enhancements! [/h2]
Explosions, lighting, and particle effects have been [b]completely overhauled[/b] for a more intense and immersive experience. Core Break has never looked better!

[h2] 🛠️ Bug Fixes & Improvements! [/h2]
[list]
[*]Performance optimizations for smoother gameplay.
[*]Fixed AI glitches and improved enemy behaviors.
[*]UI refinements for a cleaner and more intuitive experience.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h3] Ready to test the new system? [/h3]
Update now and experience Core Break like never before!
